app.verificationHelp: Your nickname comes from the Minecraft account linked to your Discord on Chromacube. Manual nickname entry is disabled. Trading requires vanilla access and no ban.
app.nicknameHelp: 3-16 characters: A-Z, a-z, digits and _. Your nickname is public.
app.photoHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB. Images are resized and compressed before upload.
app.exchangeNotice: Trade takes place in Minecraft. Agree with the seller and check the item and quantity. Confirm completion only after the exchange.
app.rulesBody: Never share passwords or sign-in codes. Your Minecraft name is verified through the account linked to your Discord on Chromacube. Trading requires vanilla access and no active ban. The seller provides the item, quantity and enchantments; this site does not inspect in-game inventories. A trade request reserves stock. Either participant may cancel an unfinished trade. Completion is recorded only after both participants confirm.
app.footer: Independent Minecraft marketplace. No wallets or online payments.

experience.adsHelp: Up to 10 banners. Administrators and owners can publish. Slides change every 7 seconds; hover, focus or a hidden tab pauses rotation. Times use your device timezone.
experience.title: Title
experience.imageHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MiB. A wide image is recommended. Images are compressed; originals are not stored.
experience.confirmDeleteBanner: Permanently delete this banner and its image?
experience.enterHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
experience.verifiedReviews: Only buyers with a completed deal can review. Up to 50 reviews are shown; the rating is based on those shown.
experience.reviewText: What went well or could be improved?
experience.reviewNotice: One review per completed deal. Published reviews cannot be edited. Do not publish personal data.
experience.noReviews: No reviews yet. Complete a first deal so a buyer can leave a review.
experience.reviewExists: A review has already been published. View it on the seller profile.
experience.noMatch: No matches. Change your search or filter.
experience.deleteMessage: Delete your message? A deleted-message marker will remain.
experience.loadOlderReply: The original message is not loaded. Use Earlier messages.

quality.scope: Filters and sorting apply to loaded listings.
quality.photoTypes: JPG, PNG or WebP. Up to 5 MiB.
quality.chatPrivate: Only participants can access the conversation.

admin.idHelp: Share this ID with the owner. This is not a password. Save your Minecraft nickname first.
admin.exactUser: Find by UID or exact Minecraft nickname
admin.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete the listing and its photo. Deals and audit log remain.
admin.reportPrivacy: Visible to you and staff. Do not send passwords, tokens or personal data. One report per target; resubmission is not allowed.
admin.sent: Report sent. A response will appear in My reports.
admin.noUser: User not found. They must sign in with Discord and save a Minecraft nickname.
admin.scope: Search covers loaded pages. Load more adds 50 records. Staff cannot access other users’ chats or deals.
admin.ownerHint: Only the owner can grant or revoke staff roles. Owners cannot be appointed, blocked or demoted on this site.
admin.blockHint: Blocking prevents new listings, messages and deal requests. Existing deals can still be cancelled or completed.
admin.hiddenHint: Hiding removes a listing from the catalog and prevents new deals. Data is not deleted; existing deals remain.
admin.accessError: Could not verify access. Refresh the page.
